publisher: Adobe Express (commercial AI video software vendor)
incomparability: Vendor survey asked selected US cross-platform video creators, not a population-based YouTube channel sample.
Respondents may post on several platforms, so YouTube, Instagram and TikTok platform percentages overlap.
More than 30 minutes and more than four hours are nested thresholds; do not add percentages.
Weekly AI-tool usage denominator is a subset of ever-users, not all 384 respondents.
Time savings, watch-time growth and sponsor growth are self-reports, not instrumented before/after experiments.
Intended tool spending is not actual future spending, upfront mandatory software cost, or a revenue increase.
Do not combine the vendor's reported minutes saved with one photography channel's measured hours to infer a net industry labor median.
There are no observed invoices, subscription costs, causal income effects, or creator net wages in this sample.
